claims: As of April 2026, Mitch Johnson is the head coach of the San Antonio Spurs.
Mitch Johnson was officially named head coach of the San Antonio Spurs in May 2025.
Mitch Johnson was named head coach following Gregg Popovich's transition to San Antonio Spurs team president.
Mitch Johnson previously served as an assistant and interim coach for the San Antonio Spurs.
Mitch Johnson led the San Antonio Spurs to a 62-win season in 2025-26.
Mitch Johnson is a former college basketball player for the Stanford Cardinal.
Mitch Johnson served as an assistant coach for the Austin Spurs from 2016 to 2019.
Mitch Johnson led the San Antonio Spurs to a 33-16 start in 2025-26.
The San Antonio Spurs 33-16 record through 49 games in 2025-26 was the team's best record through 49 games since 2016-17.
Mitch Johnson was named the Western Conference Head Coach for the 2026 NBA All-Star Game.
Mitch Johnson is only the second in San Antonio Spurs franchise history to be named Western Conference Head Coach for the NBA All-Star Game after Popovich.
Gregg Popovich remains a presence around the San Antonio Spurs team.
